name: Galgahévíz (Hungary)
description: Medium blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Galgahévíz (a white shield with crossed ears of grain and a black mole, within a yellow frame) between the name GALGAHÉVÍZ above and the year 1214 below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Galgahévíz arms in a yellow frame
